title.narrative: Chemical Industry Energy Efficiency and Emission Reduction Project

description.narrative: The proposed Chemical Industry Energy Efficiency and Emission Reduction Project will support demonstration of innovative technologies to improve energy efficiency and reduce emissions of pollutants from various plants belonging to the China National Chemical Corporation Group (ChemChina). Building up on the lessons learned from previous successful Asian Development Bank (ADB) loans in Anhui, Guangdong, Shandong, and Hebei provinces, this project proposes for the first time to directly cooperate with a large state-owned enterprise (SOE) to support industry-specific measures. It will also develop an innovative financing structure to leverage commercial cofinancing and mainstream energy service company (ESCO) participation from the beginning of project implementation. The innovative financing structure will be developed and firmed up during the early stage of the project preparatory technical assistance (PPTA) implementation.

description.narrative: Energy efficiency in and emissions from PVC and fluoropolymer production within ChemChina reduced

By 2022, 70% of PVC production of ChemChina uses mercury-free, energy-efficient technology (2013 baseline: 0%) Progress/Status: Being implemented. To date, civil works for phase 1 and phase 2 have been completed, and the equipment procurement for phase 1 and phase 2 was substantially completed. The construction of roads and rainstorm drains, underground pipeline network, pile foundation and tank area was substantially completed, with the construction of polymerization and VCM phase I equipment installation and process piping are underway. Phase 1 and phase 2 are expected be completed and put into trial operation in November 2019. Procurement and construction of phase 3 will be started in 2020 and is expected be completed by 2021. Data Source: ChemChina sustainability report

By 2022, HCF-23 emissions from ChemChina's production of fluoropolymer reduced to 0% (2013 baseline: 85%) Progress/Status: Procurement of major equipment for the plasma incineration plant for the effective avoidance of HFC-23 in the CGY plant started in August 2015 and fully completed in June 2016. The HFC-23 ‎plant has been put in operation since completion and worked reliably. As of 30 June 2019, the plasma incineration plant has incinerated 3,172 tons of fluoroform (HFC-23) to avoid emissions of 37.11 MtCO2e. The full completion acceptance for the plasma incineration plant will be finished by December 2019 Data Source: ChemChina sustainability report
